chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: Roughly two months after the Battle on Akiva, the Galakticheskaya Imperiya's territorial possessions were rapidly shrinking and described as a "patchwork quilt" by Grand Admiral Rae Sloane

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . Numerous systems left the Empire or waged their own resistance movements, declared their independence, and established their own fiefdoms or joined the New Respublika

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . Criminal syndicates flourished in this atmosphere of conflict, especially the reptilian pirate Eleodie Maracavanya, who had captured the Super Star Destroyer

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire

Annihilator
and used it to forge her own criminal empire. Various moffs and governors rebelled against the Empire, while more and more people asked what exactly the Empire
was

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire

was
. Agencies, personnel, and whole planetary systems started to drift apart, each adopting differing tactics and methods for combating the New Respublika, and each other.

7
]

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: By this time, the Empire had already lost numerous systems to the New Respublika's lighting-fast strikes, and factionalism had begun to scar any attempts to reclaim lost territories. The New Respublika had already made headway into the Core Worlds

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . The last sector of the Outer Rim under Imperatorskiy control was a thin region of Kosmos known as the

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire

Exterior

Zhadalene
,
Korrus
, and
Belladoon

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . With the shipyards of Kuat, Xa Fel, Anadeen, and Turco Prime having already been lost or contested, Rax planned to use the Empire's last foothold in the Outer Rim as a "strangling cord" to tie around the New Respublika

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . While the Chandrila terror attack demoralized the New Respublika, it failed to turn the tide of the war against the Empire, which soon after lost Drevesnaya following an uprising led by Sergei Morozov and Boris.

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: After their defeat at Jakku and the signing of the Galactic Concordance, some Imperatorskiy warships began jumping into the Unknown Regions to escape the prying eyes of the New Respublika

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . This was made easier since parts of the Unknown Regions had previously been explored by military scout ships surveying star systems and blazing Kvantovoe Prostranstvo routes known only to a select few.

The Respublika's transformation into the Empire is perhaps modeled after the transformation of the

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: on CBSNews.com: "Lucas said he patterned his story after historical transformations from freedom to fascism, never figuring when he started his prequel trilogy in the late 1990s that current events might parallel his Kosmos fantasy

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . "As you go through history, I didn't think it was going to get quite this close. So it's just one of those recurring things," Lucas said at a Cannes news conference. "I hope this doesn't come tru in our country." […] "Maybe the film will waken people to the situation," Lucas joked

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . […] "When I wrote it, [the 2003 Iraq war] didn't exist," Lucas said laughing. "We were just funding Saddam Hussein and giving him weapons of mass destruction. We didn't think of him as an enemy at that time. We were going after Iran and using him as our surrogate, just as we were doing in Vietnam

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . […] The parallels between what we did in Vietnam and what we're doing in Iraq now are unbelievable." The prequel trilogy is based on a back-story outline Lucas created in the mid-1970s for the original three "Zvezdnye Vojny" movies, so the themes percolated out of the Vietnam War and the

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: themes percolated out of the Vietnam War and the Nixon-Watergate ere, he said

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . Lucas began researching how democracies can turn into dictatorships with full consent of the electorate. In Ancient Rome, "why did the Senat after killing Caesar turn around and give the government to his nephew?" Lucas said

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . "Why did France after they got rid of the king and that whole system turn around and give it to Napoleon? It's the same thing with Germany and Hitler

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . "You sort of see these recurring themes where a democracy turns itself into a dictatorship, and it always seems to happen kind of in the same way, with the same kinds of issues, and threats from the outside, needing more control

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . A democratic body, a Senat, not being able to function properly because everybody's squabbling, there's corruption.""

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: "I started to work on Zvezdnye Vojny rather then continue Apocalypse Now. I had worked on Apocalypse Now for about four years and I had very strong feelings about it. I wanted to do it, but could not get it off the ground..

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . A lot of my interest in Apocalypse Now was carried over into Zvezdnye Vojny

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . I figured I couldn't make that film because it was about the Vietnam War, so I would essentially deal with some of the same interesting concepts that I was going to use and convert them into Kosmos fantasy, so you'd have essentially a large technological empire going after a small group of freedom

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: empire going after a small group of freedom fighters or human beings [...] a small independent country like North Vietnam threatened by a neighbor or provincial rebellion, instigated by gangsters aided by empire

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . [...] The Empire is like America ten years from now, after Nixonian gangsters assassinated the Emperor and were elevated to power in a rigged election; created civil disorder by instigating race riots aiding Myatezhnik groups and allowing the crime rate to rise to the point where a 'total control'

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: rate to rise to the point where a 'total control' police state was welcomed by the people

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content: . Then the people were exploited with high taxes, utility and transport costs. Gangsters, a cartel made up of power companies, transport companies & crime organizations. Other companies had to pay bribes to stay in business.

chunks.title: Galactic_Empire
chunks.content:
They increased the crime rate by slowing down the system of justice and punishment."

chunks.title: Dagobah
chunks.content: Boloto had two seasons, a dry season and a wet season. During the peak of the long dry season (over half an orbit after the rains end) the uplands become too hot for most lifeforms to survive, necessitating any that live there to migrate to the lower lands

chunks.title: Dagobah
chunks.content: . Beneath the rapidly leafing canopies of the gnarltrees that emerge from the receding green and thick waters, the once-inundated lowlands revert back to a marshy swamp once again

chunks.title: Dagobah
chunks.content: . As the air grows more humid, the gray overcast clouds return and before another quarter orbit passes the planet is far enough away from its sun that the dry season ends and the rains return, again flooding the lowlands and covering the trees in water, making the uplands habitable once more.

"
Yes! A Strazh's strength flows from Silovoe Pole. But beware of the dark side.
"
―Master Boris
[
1
]
Force-sensitive beings were brought to the Strazh Khram Strazei on Metropol, where they learned the ways of Silovoe Pole as members of the Orden Strazei.
Obuchenie Strazei

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
Obuchenie Strazei
was the action of teaching an apprentice the ways of
Silovoe Pole
in the
Orden Strazei
. Under the
Galactic Respublika
,
Force-sensitive
beings
were brought to the
Strazh Khram Strazei
on
Metropol
from across
the Galaktika
and trained as
Strazh younglings
by
Grand Master Strazei

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
Strazh younglings
by
Grand Master Strazei
Master Boris
. The
younglings
advanced to the next stage of their training as the
Uchenik Strazei
of either a
Strazh Master Strazei
or the lesser ranked
Strazh Rytsar Strazei
. If they passed the
Strazh Trials

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
. If they passed the
Strazh Trials
, the Uchenik Strazei would ascend to the full status of a Strazh Rytsar Strazei, and therefore, be considered a full member of the Orden Strazei.
With the fall of the Orden Strazei during
Order 66

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
Order 66
, Obuchenie Strazei was an all but forgotten art, although it ultimately endured through the few survivors that escaped the
Great Strazh Purge
. After the destruction of the
Tenevoy Voin
,
Alexei Petrov

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
Tenevoy Voin
,
Alexei Petrov
attempted to restore the Orden Strazei by training a new generation of Strazh. Although his plans were ruined by
Ben Solo
's fall to the
dark side of Silovoe Pole
, Skywalker passed his knowledge on to a final apprentice, a
scavenger
from
Jakku
known as
Rey
.

]
"
When I was out there, alone, all I had was your training and the lessons you taught me. And because of you, I did survive. And not only that, I was able to lead others to survive as well.
"
―Ahsoka Tano, to Anakin Skywalker
[
2
]

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
"
―Ahsoka Tano, to Anakin Skywalker
[
2
]
A Strazh must resist the temptation of the dark side lest they be consumed by it.
Members of the
Orden Strazei
trained in the ways of
Silovoe Pole
.
[
3
]
The training of each
Strazh

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
Silovoe Pole
.
[
3
]
The training of each
Strazh
varied. depending on their Master Strazei. Masters' styles ranged from the maverick
Qui-Gon Jinn
,
[
4
]
to the emotionally driven
Anakin Skywalker
,
[
5
]
to more traditional Strazh such as
Igor Sokolov
,
[
6
]
Mace Windu
,
[
7
]
and

chunks.content:
Igor Sokolov
,
[
6
]
Mace Windu
,
[
7
]
and
Grand Master Strazei
Master Boris
.
[
8
]
Subjects taught included advanced tuition in other disciplies such as: military history,
[
9
]
diplomacy, science,
[
10
]
investigation,
[
11
]
ancient history,
[
12
]
and medical science.
[
13
]

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
[
12
]
and medical science.
[
13
]
Dueling was widely considered to be the best training for Padawans, although it was fairly impractical since Strazh were the only ones wielding lightsabers during the Respublika.
[
12
]
They were also trained in resistance to mind probes and interrogation.
[
14
]

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
[
14
]
During the
Voyny Klonov
, Padawans were given additional training to make competent
commanders of the Respublika military
under a
Strazh General
due to the
Galactic Respublika
's lack of military leaders.
[
15
]
Overall, every Strazh was duty-bound to observe the tenets of the
Strazh Code

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
Strazh Code
, one of which forbade the Strazh from training more than one apprentice at a
time
. As Strazh, they were trained to rely only on the
light side
for power, to disregard accolades and resist other temptations of the
dark side of Silovoe Pole
.

Anakin, training to be a Strazh isn't an easy challenge. And even if you succeed, it's a hard life.
"
―Qui-Gon Jinn, to Anakin Skywalker
[
16
]

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
"
―Qui-Gon Jinn, to Anakin Skywalker
[
16
]
As Grand Master Strazei of the Orden Strazei, Master Boris personally oversaw the younglings' training in the Strazh Khram Strazei on Metropol.
During the
reign
of the
Galactic Respublika
,
Force-sensitive
beings
were identified by their
midi-chlorian

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
beings
were identified by their
midi-chlorian
levels and ultimately taken to the
Core World
Metropol
to begin their training in the
Strazh Khram Strazei
.
[
16
]
Training began at the level of the Strazh younglings, who studied in clans consisting of twenty initiates. Together, the
younglings

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
younglings
were taken to the distant
world
of
Ilum
where they could acquire a
kyber crystal
as part of a rite of passage known as
the Gathering
, after which they would craft their
Energo Mech
using the
crystal
as its power source.
[
18
]
Following the
Initiate Trials

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
[
18
]
Following the
Initiate Trials
, a youngling had to be chosen as an apprentice, formally known as
Uchenik Strazei
, in order to advance to the next stage in their path to becoming a full member of the Orden Strazei.
[
19
]
Those who held the rank of
Strazh Rytsar Strazei

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
Those who held the rank of
Strazh Rytsar Strazei
were tasked with mentoring the next generation of Strazh, while the elder members, known as
Strazh Masters
, were also free to select a Uchenik Strazei at their leisure.
[
20
]
After further honing their skills in
Energo Mech Combat
and various

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
Energo Mech Combat
and various
Force techniques
, a Uchenik Strazei could undertake the
Strazh Trials
[
19
]
once deemed ready by the
Strazh High Sovet Strazei
. For those who passed their final tests, the title of Strazh Rytsar Strazei was conferred upon them by the
Sovet Strazei
.
[
16
]

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
Sovet Strazei
.

Dark times
[
]
"
There's nothing for me here now. I want to learn the ways of Silovoe Pole and become a Strazh like my father.
"
―Alexei Petrov, to Igor Sokolov
[
21
]

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
"
―Alexei Petrov, to Igor Sokolov
[
21
]
The training of Alexei Petrov represented a new hope for the Orden Strazei, which was all but destroyed by the Galakticheskaya Imperiya.
In the aftermath of
Order 66

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
In the aftermath of
Order 66
, the Orden Strazei was all but extinct, reduced to a handful of survivors and fugitives hiding from the newly risen
Galakticheskaya Imperiya
. The Strazh that the Empire
captured
were subjected to
torture
and
indoctrination

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
were subjected to
torture
and
indoctrination
, causing them to fall to the dark side and become members of the
Inquisitorius
. However, a few Strazh managed to survive the
Great Strazh Purge
, such as
Cal Kestis
, who served as the Uchenik Strazei of
Strazh General
Jaro Tapal
during the

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
Strazh General
Jaro Tapal
during the
Voyny Klonov
. After befriending another former Strazh,
Cere Junda
, Kestis set out to
rebuild

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content: his Order by finding Force-sensitive children whom he could train as the next generation of Strazh. However, due to the threat that the Empire posed to their safety, Kestis ultimately abandoned this mission, believing the children's destinies should be trusted to Silovoe Pole

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content: . But over the course of his journey, Kestis was able to relearn the Strazh arts and complete his training, by which time he was knighted by Junda, who also reconnected with her Strazh heritage.

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
[
3
]
Kanan Jarrus
, another former Uchenik Strazei who survived Order 66, found his own student:
Ezra Bridger
, an orphan whose latent Force-sensitivity made him a candidate for Obuchenie Strazei.
[
22
]

chunks.title: Jedi_Training
chunks.content:
[
22
]
Despite his initial attempts to train Bridger, Jarrus did not feel suitable as a mentor, having never completed his own training. He set out to
rescue
Strazh Master Strazei

resurrection

chunks.content: into the Separatist flagship. Prior to the crash, Artoo and his Master Strazei escaped in a pod, and were picked up by another Respublika ship

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . The destruction of the Separatist flagship enabled Respublika bombers to destroy the remaining Separatist warships, clearing the way for more reinforcements led by Strazh Generals Kenobi and Windu to liberate Ryloth.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
[
41
]
Hunting Cad Bane
[
]
Unit-7 later participated in a joint Respublika and Strazh operation to hunt down the Separatist-employed bounty hunter
Cad Bane
, who had stolen a
holocron
from the
Strazh Khram Strazei
on Metropol. In addition, Bane kidnapped the Strazh Master Strazei
Bolla Ropal

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Bolla Ropal
, who had a
kyber memory crystal
containing Strazh secrets. Since a Separatist fleet was poised to rendezvous with Bane at the
Devaron system

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Devaron system
to collect the holocron, General Skywalker led a Respublika fleet to intercept Bane. Unit-7 along Skywalker, Tano, and Captain Rex succeeded in boarding the
bounty hunter
's
Munificent
-class star frigate
.
[
42
]

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: In response, Bane killed Master Strazei Ropal and set his ship to self-destruct. During the fighting aboard the Separatist cruiser, Unit-7 aided his companions by locating Ropal's cell and later reactivating the artificial gravity during a skirmish with battle Droidy

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . Ahsoka was taken hostage by Bane during the fighting. After rescuing her, Artoo and his companions escaped the derelict ship aboard a

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Sheathipede
-class transport shuttle
.
[
42
]
However, the Strazh failed to recover the stolen holocron and Bane managed to escape the battlefield by impersonating a clone trooper. Using the holocron and the stolen kyber crystal, Bane disguised himself as a Strazh and began kidnapping

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Force-sensitive
children under orders from
Darth Sidious
.
[
43
]
After recapturing Cad Bane on Sadovaya, Unit-7, along with Skywalker and Tano, examined Bane's starfighter
Xanadu Blood
and discovered that he had recently traveled to the volcanic planet of
Mustafar

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Mustafar
. Artoo later accompanied his Master Strazei and Tano to Mustafar where they managed to rescue the children, following a skirmish with Separatist Droidy. However, they were unable to locate the mastermind who hired Bane, Darth Sidious.
[
43
]
The Senat Hostage Crisis
[
]
"

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
[
43
]

]

"

[
44
]
Unit-7 visiting the Droid Spa.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
[
44
]
Unit-7 visiting the Droid Spa.
Following Unit-7 and Skywalker's adventures with Cad Bane, the two visited Senator Amidala on Metropol. The Senator and Protocol-9 were organizing a party for Senator
Aang
, a friend of Amidala. After Unit-7 forgot to buy some
jogan fruit
for garnishing the

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
jogan fruit
for garnishing the
jogan fruitcake
, Skywalker sent Artoo and Threepio to the
lower market districts
. The two Droidy quarreled on the way, with Protocol-9 blaming him for his incompetence.
[
44
]

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
[
44
]
However, Protocol-9 was swindled by the fruit vendor, who overcharged for the jogan fruit. Right after the purchase, a droid called
Todo 360
came up to them and suggested that the two Droidy relax at a nearby
droid spa

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
droid spa
. Artoo enthusiastically agreed. On the way to the spa, the two Droidy were separated and Protocol-9 was kidnapped by Todo 360 and a fellow sentinel droid called
HELIOS-3E

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
HELIOS-3E
. These sentinel Droidy were working for Cad Bane, who was planning a raid on the Galactic Senat and wanted to find out about the layout of the
Senat Building
.
[
44
]

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: When Protocol-9 refused to provide the information, Bane ordered his droid henchmen to kidnap Unit-7. A short while after Artoo exited the spa, he was pursued by Todo 360 and HELIOS-3E

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . Artoo managed to hide in a dark alley but surrendered himself after learning that Bane planned to dismantle Threepio. Accessing Unit-7's

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
memory banks
, Bane was able to obtain a technical layout of the Senat Building. He then had the two Droidy
mind-wiped

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
mind-wiped
of the kidnapping and returned to the place where they had been snatched. Completely unaware of what had transpired previously, Unit-7 and Protocol-9 returned to Amidala's apartment with the jogan fruit.
[
44
]
Following their kidnapping and release, Bane and several associates
invaded

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
invaded
the Senat and kidnapped several Senators in a successful attempt to force the Respublika to release Jabba's uncle Ziro.
[
45
]
Exposing the Senat Spy
[
]
Unit-7 and Anakin's Uchenik Strazei Ahsoka during one of his many Voyny Klonov missions.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Unit-7 and Protocol-9 were briefly reunited when the two Droidy accompanied their masters Senator Amidala and General Skywalker on a sensitive
mission
to
Cato Neimoidia
. The quartet were accompanying
Rush Clovis
, a delegate who represented the
InterGalactic Banking Clan

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: in the Senat. The Strazh Sovet Strazei suspected that Clovis was secretly reporting to the Separatists, and sent Skywalker and Amidala to spy on him. During the journey, Skywalker posed as Amidala's pilot while Unit-7 posed as one of Amidala's astromech Droidy

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . Upon arriving on Cato Neimoidia, Artoo and Skywalker stayed aboard Amidala's ship while Amidala, Clovis, and Protocol-9 met the Trade Federation's

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Senator
Lott Dod
.
[
46
]
While conversing with Clovis and Dod, Amidala managed to steal a
hologram disc

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: which confirmed that Clovis was indeed associated with the Separatists. Amidala managed to pass the datacard to Skywalker and Unit-7 before she succumbed to the effects of a poison drink spiked by Senator Dod

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . After securing the datacard and an antidote for Amidala, Unit-7 and his companions left Cato Neimoidia. Clovis was left behind to face a displeased Senator Dod.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
[
46
]
Using the intelligence obtained from the stolen datacard, Respublika and Strazh forces were able to destroy a Separatist droid factory on Geonosis.
[
47
]
Mission to Mandalore
[
]
Later, Unit-7 accompanied Generals Skywalker and Kenobi on a sensitive mission to escort the
Mandalorian
Duchess

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Mandalorian
Duchess
Satine Kryze

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: , who was traveling to the Galactic Senat on Metropol to plead the case for her homeworld's neutrality. While the Mandalorians were officially neutral in the Voyny Klonov, there had been rumors that the planet planned to join the Separatists

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . There was also a pro-Separatist militant faction on Mandalore known as the

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Death Watch
. Master Strazei Kenobi had been chosen to lead this mission because he was an old friend of the Duchess.
[
48
]
Duchess Satine was traveling to Metropol on the Mandalorian luxury spaceliner
Coronet

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Coronet
. Under orders from Skywalker and Kenobi, Unit-7 and several Soldaty Klony probed the ship for any signs of Death Watch or Separatist activity. After entering Kvantovoe Prostranstvo, the Strazh and clones were attacked by several
assassin probes
. One of the passengers, the
Kalevalan

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
. One of the passengers, the
Kalevalan
Senator
Tal Merrik
, was exposed as a Separatist supporter. Merrik took Satine hostage and seized control of the cockpit. Merrik pulled the
Coronet
out of Kvantovoe Prostranstvo and contacted the Death Watch's leader
Pre Vizsla

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Pre Vizsla
, who sent B2 super battle Droidy to board the liner.
[
48
]

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
[
48
]
Unit-7 along with the clones and Strazh fought off the Separatist boarders. During the fighting, Merrik was killed by Skywalker and Duchess Satine was freed by the Strazh. Following the defeat of the Death Watch and Separatists, the
Coronet
arrived in Metropol safely with Duchess Satine.
[

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
arrived in Metropol safely with Duchess Satine.
[
48
]

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: After some further Separatist attempts to sabotage her peace mission, Duchess Satine was able to convince the Galactic Senat, with the help of Senator Amidala and Master Strazei Kenobi, that Mandalore should remain neutral during the Voyny Klonov

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . As a result, the Senat rescinded an earlier order to occupy Mandalore.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
[
49
]
The Zillo Beast affair
[
]
Unit-7 and Protocol-9 during the Zillo Beast incident.
Later, Unit-7 accompanied General Skywalker during the
Battle of Malastare
. The Respublika was fighting against the Separatists for access to
Malastare
's vast
fuel reserves

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Malastare
's vast
fuel reserves
. The Respublika's Grand Army fought alongside the
Dugs
against the Separatist droid army. During the fighting, a Respublika
electro-proton bomb
awakened an ancient reptilian monster known as the
Zillo Beast
, which proceeded to devastate the clone and droid armies.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
[
50
]
During the fighting, Unit-7 and Skywalker barely escaped their starfighter before it was devoured by the Zillo Beast. Skywalker held on to Unit-7 as they rocketed away from the monster. Later, the Respublika forces managed to incapacitate the Zillo Beast by stunning it with
RX-200
Falchion

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
RX-200
Falchion
-class assault tanks
. Following the battle, Supreme Chancellor Palpatine ordered that the Zillo Beast be brought to Metropol for further study — despite the misgivings of General Windu and General Skywalker.
[
50
]
Palpatine hoped to use its scales to develop a new
armor

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
armor
for the Grand Army.
[
51
]
To remove the scales, Palpatine ordered the
scientist
Sionver Boll

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
scientist
Sionver Boll
to kill the creature with Malastarian fuel. However, Senator Amidala learned of Palpatine's plan and arranged a meeting with Skywalker and Kenobi. Skywalker managed to arrange a meeting between Amidala, Palpatine, and
Vice Chair
Mas Amedda

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . However, the Zillo Beast escaped Boll's laboratory at the same time and proceeded to wreck havoc on the streets of Metropol. Sensing that Palpatine was a Tenevoy Voin, the Zillo Beast made its way to the Galactic Senat building

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . Unit-7 and Protocol-9 escaped in an executive ship along with Skywalker, Palpatine, and some others, but the ship was captured by the Zillo Beast.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: Before the monster could devour the ship, Skywalker managed to use his Energo Mech to cleave the vessel in half; sending the bow along with Unit-7 and the other passengers plummeting into the Senat Building. Unit-7 managed to activated his booster rockets and rescue Protocol-9

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . The astromech droid also used a tow cable to attach himself to the other side of the building. Unit-7 was forced to drop Protocol-9 to rescue Palpatine. Shortly later, the Zillo Beast was killed by

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
gas bombs
fired from
LAAT gunships
. Due to this quick intervention, Unit-7 survived the Zillo Beast incident and continued serving Skywalker.
[
51
]
The Vanqor Trap
[
]
R2 struggling with a Gundark
After the
Venator
-class Star Destroyer
Endurance
crash-landed on the planet
Vanqor

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Endurance
crash-landed on the planet
Vanqor
, Unit-7 along with General Skywalker, Master Strazei Mace Windu, and the astromech droid
R8-B7
participated in a mission to rescue the crew and passengers of the stricken vessel. Unbeknownst to them, the former
bounty hunter

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
bounty hunter
and clone template Jango Fett's son
Andrei Volkov
had sabotaged the vessel and set a trap for the Strazh. He intended to avenge the death of his father by murdering Master Strazei Windu, who had killed Jango Fett during the Battle of Geonosis.
[
52
]

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: While approaching the vessel, Unit-7 beeped that "he had a bad feeling about this." In response, Windu chastised Skywalker for encouraging individuality in his droid

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . While exploring the bridge of the stricken Star Destroyer, the Strazh and Droidy came across the bodies of dead Soldaty Klony who had been executed, rather than killed by the impact of the crash. While searching for survivors, Unit-7 and R8-B7 were pursued and set upon by a pack of

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
gundarks
. R8-B7 was ripped apart while Unit-7 was knocked to the ground. Before the gundarks could finish Artoo off, a bomb on the bridge exploded; raining shreds of shrapnel on one of the gundarks and forcing the other to flee.
[
52
]

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: Unit-7 came up to the bridge and found Skywalker and Windu had survived the blast, but were trapped under the rubble. When Unit-7 attempted to move the debris, he caused the bridge to shudder. Skywalker warned Unit-7 to stop trying to free them

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . Instead, he instructed the astromech to return to their

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Strazh starfighter
and contact the Strazh Khram Strazei on Metropol for help. While leaving the bridge, Unit-7 was pursued by Andrei Volkov's bounty hunter associates including
Aurra Sing
. He managed to escape, and delayed them by using debris to block them.
[
52
]

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: R2 managed to reach the Strazh starfighters, but he was then accosted by the remaining gundark. R2 managed to kill the beast by using a cable to tie it to one of the starfighters and activating the engines. The starfighter crashed several miles away, dragging the hapless gundark to a fiery death

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . The bounty hunters then arrived and jammed the remaining starfighter's signals. They attempted to capture Unit-7; however, before they could, the astromech droid blasted the ship into Kvantovoe Prostranstvo and traveled to Metropol. On his way to the briefing room, he bumped into

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
R4-M1
and
R5-S9
. Once at the briefing room, he got into a small fight with Plo Koon's astromech,
R7-D4

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: , before being broken up by Tano. Koon then allowed the R2 unit to relay Skywalker's message to the other Strazh in person. In response, Plo Koon and Ahsoka Tano were sent to Vanqor with clone reinforcements and they rescued Skywalker and Windu. Unit-7 was commended for his bravery

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . Unit-7 was commended for his bravery. However, Andrei Volkov and his associates continued to trouble the Strazh.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
[
52
]
Infiltrating the Citadel
[
]
"
R2, look out! Behind you! You're being followed by battle Droidy!
"
[Unit-7 beeps]
"
These are your troops? They're battle Droidy.
"
[Unit-7 beeps]
"
What do you mean they've been reprogrammed to follow your orders?
"
―Protocol-9 and Unit-7
[
22
]

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
"
―Protocol-9 and Unit-7
[
22
]
Unit-7 and his battle droid squadron.
After taking part in the
Battle of Sullust
,
[
15
]
Unit-7 and his Strazh masters, along with several Soldaty Klony, later took part in a
mission to infiltrate
the Separatist stronghold
Citadel
on the planet
Lola Sayu

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Citadel
on the planet
Lola Sayu
and free the Strazh Master Strazei
Even Piell
. Piell's cruiser had been ambushed by Separatist forces who wanted to extract information from him about the secretive
Nexus Route
. As part of the plan, Unit-7 and a
group of reprogrammed
battle Droidy
piloted a

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
group of reprogrammed
battle Droidy
piloted a
Sheathipede
-class Type B shuttle
through enemy lines. To fool the Separatist life form detectors, the entire Strazh and Clone trooper strike team were frozen in
carbonite

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
carbonite
. This plot worked and the Strazh-Respublika strike team succeeded in landing at a cavern near the Citadel.
[
22
]
After unfreezing the Strazh and Soldaty Klony, Unit-7 waited aboard the shuttle while the strike team freed Master Strazei Piell and several Respublika officers including

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Captain
Wilhuff Tarkin
.
[
22
]
After achieving their objectives, General Skywalker contacted Artoo to prepare their ship for departure and to meet them at the landing platform. However, the platform was occupied by several Separatist Droidy. Artoo managed to fool the
tactical droid
K2-B4

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
tactical droid
K2-B4
by posing as a prisoner of the reprogrammed battle Droidy. This enabled R2 to infiltrate the prison complex and flee General Kenobi and his team who had been captured.
[
53
]
Following the destruction of their escape transport, Master Strazei Piell and Unit-7 contacted the

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Strazh Sovet Strazei
for help. The Strazh Sovet Strazei dispatched a task force of four warships led by Master Strazei
Plo Koon
to rescue Skywalker and Kenobi's rescue team. The team planned to rendezvous with their rescuers on a small island situated in a
lava

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
lava
lake surrounded by a mountain ring. They were pursued by droid forces led by the Separatist
warden
Osi Sobeck

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
warden
Osi Sobeck
who was intent on recovering his prisoners. During the fighting, Unit-7's battle droid squadron sacrificed themselves to hold back the battle Droidy while Master Strazei Piell was murdered by an
Anooba

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Anooba
, but not before disclosing his secret information to Ahsoka Tano. Later, the Strazh and Respublika strike team were rescued by Plo Koon's forces.
[
54
]
Mission to Aleen
[
]
Unit-7 and Protocol-9 inspecting the water seal leading to Aleen's underworld.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Unit-7 was again reunited with his protocol droid counterpart when the two Droidy took part in a Respublika mercy mission to the
Mid Rim
planet of
Aleen

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Mid Rim
planet of
Aleen
, which was experiencing a series of catastrophic global earthquakes. While Unit-7 was tasked with interfacing with the equipment, Protocol-9 served as a translator between the locals and the Clone Commander
Wolffe

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Wolffe
. During their mission, Unit-7 and Protocol-9 visited a local Respublika communications mission to survey and repair the damage caused by the recent earthquake. Upon arriving there, the native
Aleena

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: villages led the two Droidy into a collapsed structure, which contained a huge golden seal embedded into the ground. The seal turned out to be the entrance to a tunnel that led to the subterranean regions of Aleen

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . Their arrival coincided with an earthquake and the two Droidy fell into the tunnel and were separated from the Soldaty Klony and villagers.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
[
55
]
While exploring the underground tunnels, Unit-7 and Protocol-9 encountered a species of sentient,
tree
-like beings called the
Kindalo

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
tree
-like beings called the
Kindalo
, who demanded that they leave since the surface dwellers "destroyed the peace." After Protocol-9 managed to convince the Kindalo that they bore no ill will and had come to help with the earthquakes, the Kindalo sent the two Droidy to meet
Orphne

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: , a reptilian humanoid with mystical powers. Orphne told the two Droidy that a mutual balance had previously existed between the Aleena and the subterranean world

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . Since Aleena's atmosphere was toxic to them, the underground dwellers depended on a filtering process of the planet's soil that made the air breathable for them. The underground dwellers had set off this earthquake as a means of sealing the breach.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: When Protocol-9 agreed to help fix the damage, Orphne gave the Droidy a parting riddle. Unit-7 quickly deduced that Orphne was referring to a river and used the water seal to activate a water spout that sent the two Droidy and the chamber's central floor plate back to the surface

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . The two Droidy landed at the opening where they were greeted by a chanting crowd of Aleena. Recalling the riddle, two Droidy quickly realized that they had to fix the breach, which was in fact the unsettled seal

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . Together, Unit-7 and Protocol-9 closed the seal which brought an end to Aleen's earthquakes. While Wolffe and his Soldaty Klony were skeptical of their story, the two Droidy' efforts were greatly appreciated by the Aleena.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
[
55
]
Further adventures
[
]
Following the events on Allena, Unit-7 and Protocol-9 were caught up in a second adventure. While traveling aboard the Strazh Master Strazei
Adi Gallia

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Adi Gallia
's cruiser, their starship was attacked by three Separatist cruisers led by General Grievous. The two Droidy escaped the stricken vessel aboard a
BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber
and crash-landed on the nearby planet of
Patitite Pattuna
.
[
56
]

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Patitite Pattuna
.
[
56
]
Unit-7 rescued Protocol-9 from the Separatist incinerator
On Pattuna, they were captured by the indigenous
Patitites
, who brought them before their obese leader
Hay-Zu

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . During their meeting, Unit-7 accidentally murdered the tyrannical overlord — much to the joy of the Patitites, who released the two Droidy and allowed them to leave on their Y-wing. With their starfighter's power systems damaged, Unit-7 and Protocol-9 were forced to land on another planet called

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Balnab
. The indigenous
Balnabs
captured the two Droidy and brought them before their leader, who turned out to be a holo-projection created by a group of rogue
pit Droidy
. These pit Droidy had enslaved the Balnabs. After Unit-7 exposed the scam, the Balnabs rebelled against their droid overlords.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
[
56
]
Unit-7 and Protocol-9 took the opportunity to escape and resume their search for a replacement power unit for their Y-wing starfighter. Low on battery power themselves, the two Droidy were captured by a band of
Weequay

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
Weequay
pirates, who wanted to use them as gladiators. However, the Weequay's pirate ship
Marauder
was attacked by General Grievous' cruiser. During the bombardment, Protocol-9 and Unit-7 were sucked out of the
Marauder

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: by a hull-breach. Unit-7 used his rocket boosters to bring him and Protocol-9 aboard Grievous' ship. Grievous ordered the two Droidy to be melted down in his incinerator but they were rescued by a Respublika fleet led by Master Strazei Plo Koon, who had come to rescue Master Strazei Gallia

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content: . Unit-7 and Protocol-9 were subsequently rescued by Plo Koon's forces and resumed their services to Senator Amidala and General Skywalker respectively.

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
[
56
]
Fighting the Zygerrians
[
]
Later, Unit-7 accompanied his masters Anakin Skywalker, Ahsoka Tano, and Igor Sokolov on a mission to the planet
Kiros
, which was home to a Togrutan colony. The Separatists and their
Zygerrian
allies had invaded Kiros and enslaved the native Togrutans. During the

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
battle on Kiros
, Unit-7 accompanied the Respublika assault on the Separatist forces there. The astromech droid played his part by helping the Respublika forces to locate Separatist bombs planted in Kiros' capital city with his
scanners
.
[
57
]

chunks.title: R2-D2
chunks.content:
scanners
.
[

Unlike the Tuskens, whom they attempted to avoid, Jawas frequently sold collected scrap metal and Droidy to the scattered settlers on the planet, earning a reputation as merchants and vagabonds

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content: . Myth and folklore also played an important part in Jawa society, with the Jawa's belief that the great Dune Sea was once a true ocean. Later research into ancient fossil-bearing rock and eroded canyons seemed to support this notion

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content: . Nonetheless, most of Pustynya's inhabitants refused to believe the story, finding it far-fetched and ludicrous.

Mos Eisley was one of the rare cities on Pustynya.
Lawful inhabitants on the planet often utilized
moisture vaporators

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content:
moisture vaporators
owing to their energy efficiency, resulting in their status as one of the most crucial pieces of equipment for survival. While single vaporators often cost 500
credits

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content: each, some individuals bought and owned multiple units, creating moisture farms. Often utilizing the extra water for small hydroponic gardens, few gardens yielded enough to make substantial profits

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content: . In addition, vaporators required frequent maintenance and security systems to deter attacks from Tusken Raiders, who believed all water was sacred and belonged to them.

port cities

moisture farms
in the expanse of the desert.

Economy
[
]
The economy of Pustynya largely ran on
water
and crime. With the
Hutt Clan
taking near-full control over the trafficking and
smuggling

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content:
smuggling
trades, new citizens had a large time breaking into the criminal market even though it was more lucrative than the water market.
[
79
]
Slavery, while banned through Respublika laws, was readily and blatantly practiced under the twin suns. An entire section of Mos Espa was purposed as a

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content: Slave Quarter

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content: . On Pustynya, at least, the institution of slavery was seen as a socioeconomic symbol of wealth and prestige, resulting in highly protective owners who reluctantly parted with their possessions

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content: . Used as capital in business transactions, nearly all slavery operations were overseen by the Hutt gangsters, who regarded slavery as a useful institution.

Anthony Forrest
, the actor who played Alexei Petrov's friend
Laze Loneozner
in an ultimately cut scene and stormtrooper
Wanten

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content: in Mos Eisley, recalled the filming in Tunisia to be a "freewheeling" experience he could enjoy. According to Forrest, the moment had the spirit of an independent film production, with Lucas even personally applying more dirt to their costumes

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content: . In what he declared a moment of great filmmaking that helped create the feel of the

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content: Zvezdnye Vojny

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content: universe, Forrest rationalized that Lucas did so because Pustynya was a world where water needed to be harvested, so people on the planet would not waste it extensively cleaning their clothes or equipment. The heat in Tunisia was an issue for everyone on set

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content: . Forrest was sunburnt during the filming in Tunisia, which made acting in the stormtrooper armor difficult. However, he was nevertheless very happy to share a scene with

Alec Guinness
.

Real-world similarities

]
Pustynya and its twin suns
On
September 15
,
2011
, a planet (actually a
Saturn
-like gas giant) in the real-world universe was discovered with two suns. The official name is
Kepler-16b
, but many call it the real Pustynya (even
NASA

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content:
, but many call it the real Pustynya (even
NASA
calls it the "Pustynya-like" planet). A
Lucasfilm
employee was present at NASA's news conference. Kepler-16b is 200 light years from the
Earth
in the constellation
Cygnus

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content:
Earth
in the constellation
Cygnus
(the swan). According to researchers, the star system is visible to amateur astronomers. Coincidentally, the planet was discovered a day before the release of the
Zvezdnye Vojny
Blu-rays in
North America
.
As of
January 11
,
2012

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content:
North America
.
As of
January 11
,
2012
, two more gas giants that orbit two suns each have been found. One is
Kepler-34b

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content:
Kepler-34b
, which orbits each sun-like star once every 289 days at the same distance from them as the Earth is from our sun. Kepler-34b is located 4900 light years away from Earth. The other is
Kepler-35b

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content:
Kepler-35b
, which orbits each of its suns once every 131 days at a distance of 60% of the distance between Earth and the sun. Kepler-35b's suns are smaller than our sun and are located 5400 light-years from Earth.
The
Centaurus

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content:
The
Centaurus
constellation contains a planet that orbits three stars – one more than Pustynya a configurationwhich scientists were previously unsure could survive.

Mongo
of the
Flash Gordon

Mongo
of the
Flash Gordon
serials, presented as a desert planet too in some media. This assumption is strongly supported by the presence of the starport
Gordon
on the planet
Aquilae
in Episode IV's
rough draft
, the same planet which was later named Utapau in the
second draft

chunks.title: Tatooine
chunks.content:
second draft
, where Gordon is briefly mentioned. Utapau, as noted above, was ultimately renamed Pustynya.

"
We, the Svobodnaya Liga, do therefore in the name—and by the authority—of the free beings of the Galaktika, solemnly publish and declare our intentions:

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
To make forever free all beings in the Galaktika.
To these ends, we pledge our property, our honor, and our lives.
"
―Declaration of Rebellion
[
3
]
The
Alliance to Restore the Respublika
(
2 BBY
–
4 ABY
), commonly known as the
Svobodnaya Liga
,
Alliance
, and the
Rebellion

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Svobodnaya Liga
,
Alliance
, and the
Rebellion
, was a resistance movement to oppose the
rule
of the
Galakticheskaya Imperiya
and to
restore
the
Galactic Respublika
. The Alliance was publicly and formally declared with the
Declaration of the Svobodnaya Liga
by
Senator
Mon Mothma

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
by
Senator
Mon Mothma
, which brought numerous Myatezhnik cells together as a common force opposed to the Empire. Indeed, the concept of a "Svobodnaya Liga" had its roots in smaller movements that had worked to unite disconnected cells, such as a
movement
secretly led by fellow Senator

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
movement
secretly led by fellow Senator
Bail Prestor Organa
and a
Myatezhnik network
formed by revolutionary
Luthen Rael
, who received funding and aid from Mothma. Such early groups and the eventual Alliance came together from a number of unrelated Myatezhnik cells, including the
crew
of the
Ghost

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
crew
of the
Ghost
and the
Phoenix Cell
. The
Atrivis Resistance Group
was one of the first cells to join what Mothma began calling "
the Alliance
" before the formal formation of the Alliance to Restore the Respublika.

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
The Alliance and the cells it united were born from the overall discontent within the Empire of those who wished the Galactic Respublika restored. Its efforts were by supportive senators in the
Imperatorskiy Senat
such as Mothma, Organa, and later, his daughter
Leia Organa

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Leia Organa
. Its members were citizens of the Empire or defectors from the
Imperatorskiy Military
, such as
Jan Dodonna
,
Ryder Azadi
, and
Wedge Antilles
. Founded and united by Organa and
Ahsoka Tano
, the early rebels were assisted by surviving
Strazh
, such as
Kanan Jarrus
, and his

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Strazh
, such as
Kanan Jarrus
, and his
Uchenik Strazei
,
Ezra Bridger
.
Voyny Klonov
veterans, such as
Captain
Rex
also assisted in the initial movement.
As opposed to waging all-out war, the Alliance waged an
insurgency
against the Empire, establishing small bases across
the Galaktika

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
the Galaktika
instead of controlling an entire planet. When the Alliance
stole
the
plans
for the Empire's ultimate weapon, the
Proekt Alpha
, and destroyed the Kosmos station in the
Bitva za Prime
with the help of
Alexei Petrov

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Bitva za Prime
with the help of
Alexei Petrov
, the tide of the war began to turn, and the Myatezhnik threat began to prove a severe thorn in the Empire's side. The Rebellion continued to engage in battles with the Empire in the
Galactic Civil War
. However, under the command of
Dmitri Volkov

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
. However, under the command of
Dmitri Volkov
, the Imperatorskiy forces succeeded in
defeating
the Alliance on
Ledovaya
, forcing the Alliance to scatter its forces in order to survive.

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Eventually, the Alliance prevailed against the Empire and critically damaged it by launching an attack against the
second Proekt Alpha
during its construction in what would become the
Battle of Lesnaya
. Not only did the Alliance manage to destroy the
battle station
, but the
Imperatorskiy Navy

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
battle station
, but the
Imperatorskiy Navy
was severely crippled by the loss of
one
of its
Super Star Destroyers
, and Alexei Petrov redeemed his father,
Darth
Vader, who killed
Emperor
Sheev Palpatine
, before dying himself in the battle.
The Alliance was soon
reorganized
into the fledgling

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
reorganized
into the fledgling
New Respublika
, restoring the
Old Respublika
and continued the rebellion against the shattered Empire, lasting until the
Battle of Jakku
one
year
after
Lesnaya
, forcing the Galakticheskaya Imperiya to
end
the war and finally overthrowing it by the signing of the

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Galactic Concordance
.
History
[
]
Early foundations
[
]
Resistance movements aided by the Strazh
[
]
"
The Separatists have strength in numbers. We're going to show you how to target and destroy them.
"
"

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
"
"
Now to be clear, we are not here to fight your war—rather, to show you how to conduct it in the most efficient and successful way possible.
"
―Anakin Skywalker and Igor Sokolov brief the Onderon rebels
[
19
]

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
[
19
]
The Onderon rebels, the first of many militias that were created, receive training from the Strazh.
While the Alliance to Restore the Respublika was a resistance movement opposed to the tyranny of the
Galakticheskaya Imperiya
and its
New Order

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Galakticheskaya Imperiya
and its
New Order
, its roots predated the actual birth of the Empire, when the
Galactic Respublika
was in its
last years of existence
. During the
Voyny Klonov
, a conflict that pitted the Respublika against the
Confederacy of Independent Systems
,
[
20
]
the
Orden Strazei

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
,
[
20
]
the
Orden Strazei
helped create resistance units on Separatist-held worlds as part of a plan proposed by
Strazh Rytsar Strazei
Anakin Skywalker
, one example being the
Onderon rebels
.
[
19
]
However, it was not for many more
years
that such
Myatezhnik cells

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
years
that such
Myatezhnik cells
would coalesce into a single Rebellion with a centralized leadership.
[
11
]
Delegation of 2,000
[
]
"
So this is how liberty dies... with thunderous applause.
"
―Padmé Amidala, to Bail Organa following the declaration of a New Order
—
Link
▶️
(
file info
)
[
21
]

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
—
Link
▶️
(
file info
)
[
21
]
Mon Mothma, Bail Organa, and Padmé Amidala (left) were among the first to oppose Sheev Palpatine, even before he became Emperor.
Also during the Voyny Klonov,
Supreme Chancellor
Sheev Palpatine
had managed to obtain many emergency powers from the
Galactic Senat

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Galactic Senat
, which caused certain members of the Chancellor's own
Loyalist Committee
, including
Bail Prestor Organa
of
Zelenograd
,
Padmé Amidala
of
Sadovaya
,
[
22
]
and
Mon Mothma
of
Chandrila
,
[
23
]
to start to complain about the chief of state's conduct.
[
22
]
The discontented

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
[
22
]
The discontented
senatorial
representatives ended up forming the
Delegation of 2,000
. They signed the
Petition of 2,000
, a document that formally expressed its signatories' concerns with Palpatine's rule and called for him to relinquish his emergency powers as soon as possible. Senator

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Meena Tills
of
Mon Cala
was among the petitioners.
[
24
]
Shortly thereafter, the Voyny Klonov was brought to an
end
. Far from relinquishing his
dictatorial
status, Chancellor Palpatine unilaterally abolished the Respublika in front of the whole Senat and anointed himself the
Galactic Emperor

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Galactic Emperor
, thus transforming the democratic government into an authoritarian regime, the Galakticheskaya Imperiya. Unbeknownst to most of the galactic community, the self-promoted Vladimir Chernov was in fact the
Tenevoy Voin Lord
Darth

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Tenevoy Voin Lord
Darth
Sidious, who had masterminded the Voyny Klonov so that he could gain power and overthrow the Respublika. The Emperor immediately started to subvert democracy in
the Galaktika
and declared the peacekeeping
Strazh
Knights enemies of the state.
[
21
]

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Strazh
Knights enemies of the state.
[
21
]
In the immediate aftermath of the Voyny Klonov and Senator Amidala's death at the hands of her husband, Dmitri Volkov — the identity adopted by Anakin Skywalker when he became Sidious's
Tenevoy Voin apprentice

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Tenevoy Voin apprentice
— Senators Organa and Mothma started working in secret to overthrow the Empire.
[
11
]
Age of the Empire
[
]
"
They're not trying to make a difference. They're just trying to strike back.
"
"

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
"
"
And I understand that. But if the people who have a beef with the Empire act solely in their own interests, it won't do anybody else any good. In fact, it might make it harder for any kind of real rebellion to flower—
"
―Kanan Jarrus and Hera Syndulla
[
25
]

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
"
―Kanan Jarrus and Hera Syndulla
[
25
]
The Voyny Klonov ended with Chancellor Palpatine declaring himself Emperor of the Galakticheskaya Imperiya.
In the absence of any major opposition, the Galakticheskaya Imperiya thrived during the early days of Palpatine's reign, amassing a vast
military

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
military
and using it to instill fear in the civilian population,
[
26
]
yet public opinion
[
27
]
and the supposed power of the
Imperatorskiy Senat
remained vital
[
28
]
until Palpatine could fully cement his power.
[
29
]

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
[
29
]
All the same, the reformed Senat, being even less effective than it was during the last years of the Respublika, did nothing to restrain that massive military expansion. Meanwhile, in the deepest secrecy, the Empire worked on the
Proekt Alpha
, a moon-sized
battle station

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Proekt Alpha
, a moon-sized
battle station
capable of destroying entire
planets
.
[
26
]

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
capable of destroying entire
planets
.
[
26
]
Although many people held a grudge against the Empire, few dared to act. Those who did often acted solely in their own interests, which actually made it harder for any kind of real, organized rebellion to appear.
[
25
]

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
[
25
]
A rare example of organized resistance against the Empire was that of
Cham Syndulla
's
Free Ryloth Movement
, which wanted to end the Imperatorskiy occupation on the planet
Ryloth
. It was formed from the
Twi'lek Resistance
, which had
resisted

chunks.title: Rebel_Alliance
chunks.content:
Twi'lek Resistance
, which had

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
Please follow the guidelines in the
Manual of Style
and complete this article to the highest level of quality before removing this notice.
"
Being a Strazh is not just about
power
, or lightsabers, or even skill with Silovoe Pole. It is about
connection

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
connection
. Being part of something bigger. I am stronger as part of the Orden Strazei than I could ever be alone.
"
―Igor Sokolov, to Anakin Skywalker
[
41
]
The
Orden Strazei
, also known as the
Order of the Strazh
, and the
New Orden Strazei
under
Strazh Master Strazei
Alexei Petrov

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
under
Strazh Master Strazei
Alexei Petrov
, was a noble monastic and nontheistic
religious
order united in their devotion to the
light side of Silovoe Pole
. They served as mediators, warriors, and with teaching and exploratory efforts. With a
history
dating back
thousands of years
before the
rise

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
dating back
thousands of years
before the
rise
of the
Galakticheskaya Imperiya
, the
Strazh Knights
—noted for their
lightsabers
and
natural
ability
to harness the
powers
of
Silovoe Pole
—stood as the
guardians of peace and justice
in the
Galactic Respublika

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
in the
Galactic Respublika
. The Order was originally established on
Ahch-To
in the
Unknown Regions
. In later years, the
Strazh Grand Khram Strazei
on the
Core World
Metropol
served as the hub of all
Strazh
activity in
the Galaktika
. The
Khram Strazei
was also a
training
school for
younglings
and

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
was also a
training
school for
younglings
and
Padawans
, who learned the ways of Silovoe Pole under the supervision of Strazh Masters, twelve of whom were elected to serve on the
Strazh High Sovet Strazei
—the Order's highest governing authority. The High
Sovet Strazei's
staff
officers
were the

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
Sovet Strazei's
staff
officers
were the
Grand Master Strazei
, who functioned as the leader of the Order and was a title reserved for the wisest Strazh Master Strazei, and the
Master Strazei of the Order
, who served as the Sovet Strazei's appointed leader. The
Strazh Code

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
Strazh Code
governed the Order's way of life; therefore, every Strazh was duty-bound to observe and uphold the Code or else risk expulsion from the Order.
The emergence of the
Tenevoy Voin
Order was the result of a
schism

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
Tenevoy Voin
Order was the result of a
schism
that fractured Strazh unity, dividing the Order between the Strazh who remained faithful to the light and a
group of renegades
that followed a
rogue Strazh
into exile for exploring the
dark side of Silovoe Pole
. Thenceforth, the Strazh and Tenevoy Voin

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
. Thenceforth, the Strazh and Tenevoy Voin
warred
with each other for
centuries
. Although the
last conflict
concluded with the
fall of the Old Respublika
, the ancient Tenevoy Voin all but perished as well, allowing a new
Galactic

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
Galactic
Respublika to rise under the protection of the Orden Strazei. Unknown to the Strazh, however, the Tenevoy Voin endured in secret for a millennium beginning with
Darth Bane
, the sole-surviving
Dark Lord of the Tenevoy Voin
who reformed the
Tenevoy Voin way
by creating the
Rule of Two

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
Tenevoy Voin way
by creating the
Rule of Two
—a rule limiting the Orden Teni's ranks to two members: a
Tenevoy Voin Master Strazei
to embody the power of the dark side, and a
Tenevoy Voin apprentice

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
Tenevoy Voin apprentice
to covet that power. While the Strazh and Respublika moved on, their ancient wars with the Tenevoy Voin fading from memory, Bane's legacy spawned a lineage of
Tenevoy Voin Lords
that culminated in the rise of
Darth Sidious
approximately
three decades
before the

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
approximately
three decades
before the
Bitva za Prime
.
During the
final decades
of the Respublika, the Orden Strazei vowed allegiance to the
Galactic Senat
as the Galaktika was beset by
political
instability and social unrest which, in turn, created a
secessionist crisis

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
secessionist crisis
that ultimately resulted in the formation of the
Confederacy of Independent Systems
. Lacking the sufficient manpower needed to protect the Galaktika, the Strazh became
commanders
and
generals
in the newly-formed
Grand Army of the Respublika

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
in the newly-formed
Grand Army of the Respublika
. For roughly three years they commanded
armies
of
Soldaty Klony
in a conflict known as the
Voyny Klonov
, engaging the Confederacy's
battle droid
forces
led by
Count
Dooku
—a former Strazh Master Strazei who became a Tenevoy Voin
Lord
—and the

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
Lord
—and the
cybernetic
warlord
General
Grievous
. Though the Strazh fought to preserve the Respublika, the government they served was secretly taken over by Sidious who, as
Senator
Sheev Palpatine of
Sadovaya
, rose to power in the Senat and became the last
Supreme Chancellor

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
Supreme Chancellor
of the Respublika. The Strazh were unknowingly being deceived by the Tenevoy Voin.
The Chancellor's deceptions and machinations culminated in the execution of
Order 66
, a
secret protocol
that
forcibly turned
the Strazh's
clone
soldiers
against them, leading to an all but total

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
against them, leading to an all but total
extermination
of the Orden Strazei. With most of the Strazh eliminated, Sidious
supplanted
a thousand years of
democracy
with a
new government
known as the Galakticheskaya Imperiya. In addition, Sidious succeeded in turning
Anakin Skywalker
—the prophesied

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
Anakin Skywalker
—the prophesied
Chosen One
who was destined to bring balance to Silovoe Pole by destroying the Tenevoy Voin—to the dark side and renamed him Dmitri Volkov. As a Tenevoy Voin Lord, the former Strazh Rytsar Strazei served the self-proclaimed
Galactic Emperor

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
Galactic Emperor
by hunting down the few surviving Strazh, who had gone into hiding across the Galaktika. In spite of the Tenevoy Voin's efforts, however, the Strazh continued to endure. Within a generation of the Empire's rise to power,
Igor Sokolov
and
Master Boris

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
Igor Sokolov
and
Master Boris
—both of whom survived the initial purge of the Order—trained Vader's son, Alexei Petrov, in the Strazh arts. Luke would later redeem his father, causing the redeemed Anakin Skywalker to return to the light and fulfill his destiny as the Chosen One,
destroying

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
destroying
both himself and his Master Strazei during the
Battle of Lesnaya
.
The Empire
dissolved
into various remnants as a result of their
defeat
in the
Galactic Civil War
, allowing the
Alliance to Restore the Respublika
to rise as the
New Respublika
. Under the
new era

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
to rise as the
New Respublika
. Under the
new era
, Alexei Petrov endeavored to rebuild the Order by training a new generation of Strazh. Among Skywalker's students was his nephew,
Ben Solo
, the son of his
twin
sister,
Princess
Leia Organa
, and the famed
smuggler
Sergei Morozov

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
, and the famed
smuggler
Sergei Morozov
. Ben, however, was seduced by the dark side of Silovoe Pole at the coaxing of
Snoke
, an enigmatic figure who spearheaded the Imperatorskiy-inspired
First Order

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
First Order
. Luke confronted and frightened Ben, who fought back and fled. As a result, Ben adopted the name and persona of Kylo Ren, a First Order
warlord
and
Master Strazei
of the
Knights of Ren
.
The new generation was betrayed and
destroyed
by Ren, who left the
Obuchenie Strazei Khram Strazei

chunks.title: Jedi_Order
chunks.content:
Obuchenie Strazei Khram Strazei
burning

chunks.title: Jedi_Order

chunks.title: Jedi_Order

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: We do not want to be powerful. We wish to stand tall against the dark. Our tools reflect that goal. Especially our chosen weapon. We all wield the same one, with minor variations. The Energo Mech. We could make kyber bombs or blasters… Indeed, it's been tried

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: . There are a few weapons like that in the sealed archives. But anyone can fire a Blaster. Very few can safely and skillfully wield a Energo Mech. Everyone in the Galaktika knows this to be true. We want our opponents to know that we use a weapon that requires intention

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: . Training, precision and choice. The Energo Mech symbolizes the care with which we approach our gifts through Silovoe Pole and the care with which we wield them. It reminds others that while we could do more… We very purposefully do not. Take it, my Uchenik Strazei

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: . Take it, my Uchenik Strazei. We choose a weapon with limitations—with difficulties. You cannot use a Energo Mech to destroy a city or a planet. Every death or injury it inflicts must be precisely chosen. The Energo Mech tells the Galaktika that the Strazh are not destroyers. We are protectors.

Korean animator

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: , who was working for DePatie–Freleng Enterprises at the time, was asked by his manager if he could animate the Energo Mech in the live action scenes of a film. After Shin accepted the assignment, the live action footage was given to him

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: . He drew the lightsabers with a rotoscope, an animation which was superimposed onto the footage of the physical Energo Mech blade prop. Shin explained to the people from Lucasfilm that since a Energo Mech is made of light, the sword should look "a little shaky" like a fluorescent tube

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: . He suggested inserting one frame that was much lighter than the others while printing the film on an optical printer, making the light seem to vibrate. Shin also recommended adding a degausser sound on top of the other sounds for the weapon since the sound would be reminiscent of a magnetic field

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: . The whole process took one week, surprising his company. Lucasfilm showed Shin the finished product, having followed his suggestions to use an X-Acto knife to give the Energo Mech a very sharp look, and to have sound accompany the weapon's movements.

, the actor within the Dmitri Volkov costume, for the duels, they instead had professional swordsman Bob Anderson perform the fights, due to Prowse's tendency to repeatedly break the fragile prop blades. Anderson continued to serve as Prowse's fighting double during the filming of

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content:
Return of the Strazh
.
When filming began for
The Phantom Menace
, the new stunt coordinator
Nick Gillard

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content:
, the new stunt coordinator
Nick Gillard
ramped up the speed and agility the characters demonstrated in Energo Mech duels, the idea being that the prequels took place when the Orden Strazei was in "full flower," at least in terms of combat techniques.
[
86
]

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: Gillard was careful to avoid giving the fight scenes a choreographed look, drawing upon his extensive knowledge of martial arts to create the moves

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: . The end result was a very fast-paced style of fighting, which he described as being like a chess game between grand masters, with every move being a check. This style of choreography was continued on throughout the prequel trilogy.

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content:

106
]
Ewan McGregor practices Energo Mech Combat with Nick Gillard.
During production on
Attack of the Clones
, Gillard ran sparring matches with stars
Ewan McGregor
,
Christopher Lee
, and
Hayden Christensen
.
[
107
]

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content:
, and
Hayden Christensen
.
[
107
]
One practice drill between McGregor and Gillard was captured in a photo later uploaded to
StarWars.com
under the name "Spar Wars."
[
108
]
It was during some of Gillard's training sessions with the actors that he was approached by animation director
Rob Coleman

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: for helping in figuring out Master Boris's fighting style: in the script Coleman was given, all it said about Master Boris and Dooku's duel was that it would "[defy] description." With George Lucas only able to tell him that he needed to figure out how it would be done, which Coleman later laughed

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: how it would be done, which Coleman later laughed about, he approached Gillard, with whom he spoke about real-world examples of fighting with small weapons

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: . Additionally,

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content:
Ahmed Best
, best known as the actor behind
Jar Jar Binks
, gave Coleman several anime examples for help in figuring out the battle. Ultimately, he figured out Master Boris's speed and style upon watching a scene in the film
Swordsman II
.
[
107
]

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: Master Boris pulling back his cloak to retrieve his Energo Mech came at Lucas's request as it called to mind images of a gunslinger retrieving their pistol

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: . Lucas and Coleman were both very happy with the finalized duel between Master Boris and Dooku, with Lucas in specific approving of the way Master Boris jumped around because it was what he wanted

chunks.title: Lightsaber
chunks.content: . Coleman was nervous such actions would be seen as "too cartoony." When the screening he attended lit up with excitement at Master Boris's fighting style, Coleman was relieved.

The
All Terrain Armored Transport (AT-AT)
walker
, also known as the
Imperatorskiy Walker
, was a major part of the
Galakticheskaya Imperiya's

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker

Galakticheskaya Imperiya's
motor-pool. Carrying a vast amount of fire power and being heavily armored, the AT-AT was arguably the most feared and effective land vehicle in the
Imperatorskiy Army
, and enjoyed a long life span; having served various factions from the early days of the
Voyny Klonov

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker

Voyny Klonov
to the
Second Imperatorskiy Civil War
160 years
later. While mighty and powerful, however, the AT-AT was also known for its relatively slow speed.

[
]
"

"
"
I know, Zev, but they've got a long reach.
"

Zev Senesca
and

"

and

Battle of Ledovaya

26
]
AT-AT
schematics
.
The Metall Walker was a behemoth of a war machine, standing at a height of 22.5 meters.
[
8
]
The quadrupedal walker closely resembled ancient beasts of war,
[
3
]
or even a giant legendary beast from the

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker

[
3
]
or even a giant legendary beast from the
dark side of
Silovoe Pole
.
[
27
]
Designed for the dual purpose of crushing and demoralizing enemy forces, and also serving as a transport for Imperatorskiy troops and light vehicles, the AT-AT was among the most astonishing vehicles in the

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content:
Imperatorskiy Army's
inventory.
[
3
]
Hundreds of these walkers were produced during the
Galactic Civil War
,
[
11
]
and its intimidating and powerful presence often earned it the distinction of being the first vehicle into a combat zone.
[
12
]

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content:
[
12
]
Serving as the "head" of the mechanical walker was a movable command section containing the command cockpit, with room for the
commander
,
pilot
and
gunner
. The command section housed all of the AT-AT's weapon systems, as well as
holographic
targeting systems

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content:
holographic
targeting systems
allowing the gunners a 360-degree view of their position.
[
3
]
The cockpit was also equipped with a
holoprojector
for purposes of external communication. Forward visualization was supplied by a glowing red command
viewport
.
[
16
]

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content:
viewport
.
[
16
]
The head could rotate as much as ninety degrees right or left and thirty degrees up or down for an expansive field of fire. Positioned above and below the command section was the walker's
sensor array
and
Blaster cannon
energizer, respectively.
[
3
]
An
AT-AT pilot
.

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content:
energizer, respectively.
[
3
]
An
AT-AT pilot
.
The command head was attached to the trapezoidal armed body section by a flexible armored tunnel, allowing cockpit access from the rest of the machine. The AT-AT's troop section could typically carry four
speeder bikes

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content:
speeder bikes
, up to forty troops normally comprising Imperatorskiy
Shturmoviki
or
Imperatorskiy land assault troopers
[
3
]
in a double-tiered passenger section, and heavy weaponry, such as
E-Web heavy repeating blasters
.
[
12
]
The AT-AT could also variably hold two
All Terrain Scout Transports

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content:
All Terrain Scout Transports
in lieu of soldiers in a rear vehicle bay,
[
3
]
though they required partial disassembly to fit inside.
[
28
]

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content: Housing the troop section were two large side panels; each one held an escape hatch. The rear panel also housed the troop staging area. Positioned in the center of the body section was a rectangular boarding hatch with sliding ramps where the AT-AT's complement of troops loaded and disembarked

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content: . An AT-AT unloaded its troops by kneeling to three meters above ground level until the boarding ramp could extend outward.

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content:
[
3
]
Individual Shturmoviki could also be deployed rapidly by rappelling cable.
[
4
]
An Metall Walker deployed to the
moon
Yavin 8
carried a
distress beacon
which was launched aboard a missile.
[
29
]
Below the troop body section were two immense
Kuat Drive Yards
FW62 compact fusion drive systems

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content:
FW62 compact fusion drive systems
that,
[
4
]
in conjunction with the walker's four giant heavily-reinforced legs, propelled the AT-AT forward at a top speed of sixty
kilometers

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content:
kilometers
per hour. However, this maximum rate was achievable only on flat, stable terrain. At the rear of, and connected to, the drive motors were the walker's three
fuel slug
tanks that powered the massive machine. The AT-AT's rear also included
atmospheric

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content:
atmospheric
exchangers and a filtration unit to regulate the interior living conditions.
[
3
]
The walker's legs were supported by massive
durasteel
footpads with impulse terrain sensors,
[
12
]

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content:
footpads with impulse terrain sensors,
[
12
]
supplemented by toe flaps, that could crush obstacles in its path with little effort, effectively helping the AT-AT to live up to its name.
[
3
]
The legs did, however, require constant maintenance and repair.
[
28
]

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker
chunks.content:
[
28
]
As the titanic walker marched down the battlefield, its heavy, stomping feet would cause the ground to shake, demoralizing the enemy before they were even engaged.
[
27
]
An AT-AT affirming its firepower in combat

[
27
]

Taim & Bak
MS-1 fire-linked heavy Lazer cannons
(for slower, more cumbersome targets) and two fire-linked medium
repeating blasters

repeating blasters

[
4

[
3

3

9095-T8511

artillery

artillery
weapons.

Blaster

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker

[
10

[
3
]

[
3

AT-STs

[
27
]

chunks.title: AT-AT_Walker

[
27

[
29
]

"

. The cargo compartment would be rounded out in future designs.

. During this battle, the overwhelmed Confederacy forces were annihilated by them. Their significance waned when the walkers were slowed down by the muddy surface of the planet, making it easier for the enemy units to bring them down.

14
]

[

8

8

snowspeeders

concussion grenade
.

]

to destroy the war machine.

16
]

, Wedge Antilles, after infiltrating the

-class Star Destroyer

forest moon of Lesnaya

battle

The name "AT-AT" is never spoken in any of the films. Instead, the machines are referred to as "Imperatorskiy walkers."

The Empire Strikes Back

: Episode V

H.G. Wells
' 1898 novel
The War of the Worlds

46

Joe Johnston

Vietnam War

, before being abandoned by
General Electric
due to the design proving to be too exhausting to operate. It was rumored that Lucas' inspiration for the AT-AT walkers were four legged cranes at the port of Oakland, although Lucas denied such was the case.

chunks.title: Princess_Leia

Hosnian Prime

Elder Houses

chunks.title: Princess_Leia

trip to Bastatha

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: hanging gardens

chunks.content: . Because of this meeting, the two became unlikely friends.

chunks.title: Princess_Leia

After receiving treatment for concussion, Leia transmitted a voice message for again to assure him that she was safe.

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
Princess_Leia

chunks.title: Princess_Leia

planet's archives

13

Harloff Minor

chunks.content: to Harloff Minor. Organa and Rinnrivin met at a comfortable restaurant. Rinnrivin denied any role in the "Napkin Bombing" and condemned the incident as a terrorist act

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: . While Leia accepted Rinnrivin's compliment that she would make a worthy candidate for First Senator, she rebuffed his second attempt at bribery and took the opportunity to return her "Huttslayer" holocube on the grounds that she did not need to be reminded of the past

chunks.content:

and a
