chunks.content: . Knowing Casterfo's hatred for Dmitri Volkov, she informed Casterfo about Leia's parentage.

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: Feeling betrayed by Leia, Ransolm upstaged the Senat hearing on Organa's nomination for First Senator by revealing her true parentage as Dmitri Volkov's daughter. After Casterfo presented her keepsake chest and music box as evidence, Leia confirmed that she was indeed Dmitri Volkov's daughter

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: . This revelation turned much of the Galactic Senat except for her friends Tai-Lin Garr and Varish Vicly against her and effectively destroyed her political career

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: . After barricading herself and her staff in her Senat office, Leia consoled herself by watching a holographic recording of her late adopted father Bail Organa. She then penned a message to her son to comfort him about the recent revelations concerning their family's ancestry.

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: While Korrie stormed off in outrage at Leia's perceived indiscretion, Protocol-9 along with Joph and Greer remained loyal to her. Leia and her remaining team resolved to stop Rinnrivin's cartel and the Amaxine warriors

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: . The following day, Leia marched into Casterfo's office and confronted her former friend. Casterfo responded that he had been a fool for sharing his most personal and painful life stories with Leia, never guessing that she was Vader's daughter

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: . When Leia revealed that she had not shared her true parentage with her son, Casterfo pointed out that Ben was no longer a child but a man. After destroying one of Casterfo's glass display cases and knocking a noodle carton out of a

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content:
servant droid's
hands, Leia stormed out of Casterfo's office.

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: After regaining her composure, Leia addressed the Galactic Senat to formally withdraw her nomination for First Senator and to seek permission for leave

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: . Following her speech, Lady Carise took the opportunity to cast doubt on Alexei Petrov's integrity since the Strazh Master Strazei had kept a low profile for many years

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: . In response, Leia pointed out her brother's services for the Rebellion and the New Respublika including his role in destroying the first Proekt Alpha.

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: Fortunately for Leia, Tai-Lin Garr spoke in Luke's defense and reiterated that the New Respublika did not blame children for the sins of their parents

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: . While accepting the withdrawal of Leia's candidacy, he defended Leia's past record and stressed that she retained his personal friendship and support. The Senat then discussed her request to obtain a brief leave of absence from her duties

chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: . After some deliberation, the Senat reluctantly approved her request. chunks.title: Princess_Leia
chunks.content: . In addition, Protocol-9 found that Rinnrivin was linked to nameless sources on Centrist worlds. Leia feared that the Amaxine warriors were planning a major military buildup or that a coalition of Centrist worlds was preparing for war

chunks.content: . In addition, Protocol-9 uncovered information about a large Centrist base within the underwater city.

chunks.title: Princess_Leia

chunks.title: Princess_Leia

In George Lucas's

Kayos

third draft

chunks.title: Princess_Leia

third draft

Zelenograd

, or

, was an
ecumenopolis
—a
city
-covered
planet
, collectively known as
Imperatorskiy City
— in the
Metropol system
of the
Core Worlds

chunks.title: Coruscant

— in the
Metropol system
of the
Core Worlds
. Metropol was ancient
homeworld
of the
Taung
and
Zhell
species
. Though debated by
historians
, the theory that Metropol was the ancestral world of
humans
remained unproven. Noted for its cosmopolitan culture and towering
skyscrapers

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
skyscrapers
, Metropol's population consisted of trillions of
citizens
hailing from a vast array of both
humanoid
and
alien
species. In addition, Metropol's strategic location at the end of several major
trade routes

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
trade routes
enabled it to grow in power and influence, causing the city-planet to surpass its early rivals and become the hub of
galactic
culture, education, finance, fine arts,
politics
and technology. It was the location of several major landmarks, including the
Strazh Khram Strazei
,

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
Strazh Khram Strazei
,
Monument Plaza
, and the
Senat Building
.
Serving as the
capital
of
the Galaktika
since the ancient
days
of the old
Galactic Respublika
, Metropol was at the center of many
historic events
, such as the
Orden Strazei
's
conflict
with the
Tenevoy Voin
. Although the planet

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
with the
Tenevoy Voin
. Although the planet
fell
under Tenevoy Voin control for a
time
, Respublika forces ultimately
liberated Metropol
with the aid of the
Strazh Knights
. Their victory was so decisive that at one point the Tenevoy Voin became all but extinct, replacing an

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
age of darkness and strife
with the
democratic rule
of the modern Galactic Respublika. Retaining its status as galactic capital, it was on Metropol where the
Galactic Senat
governed the Galaktika for
centuries
, establishing an
era
of
peace
that lasted for almost a
millennium

era
of
peace
that lasted for almost a
millennium
under the protection of the

peacekeepers
. However, political intrigue wrought by corruption and
secession
transformed Metropol into a dangerous environment by the time of the
Voyny Klonov
with the

. On the

. On the
eve
of the

, fulfilling a
grand scheme
,

, who was, in fact, the

Sidious, declared the Strazh
enemies of the state
, resulting in a
Galaktika-wide purge

, resulting in a
Galaktika-wide purge
that all but destroyed the Orden Strazei. Without the Strazh to oppose him, Palpatine dissolved the Respublika and
declared
himself
Galactic Emperor
to the applause of the now
Imperatorskiy Senat
.

chunks.title: Coruscant

to the applause of the now

.
Metropol continued to serve as galactic capital under the Empire, having become the Emperor's
throneworld
, although Palpatine himself disappeared from public view for the most part, leaving the
day
-to-day governing to his
advisors
in the

day
-to-day governing to his
advisors
in the

. The Empire maintained a firm hold on Metropol throughout the Emperor's
reign
, but with his defeat at the

in
4 ABY
by the
Alliance to Restore the Respublika

celebrated

. Unable to command the
military
's allegiance as the rebels

's rule was limited to Metropol while

, the self-proclaimed
Counselor to the Empire

control of the collapsing Imperatorskiy government. Hoping to escape prosecution for war crimes, Amedda ultimately surrendered himself to the
New Respublika
in return for amnesty. Following Rax's death at the
Battle of Jakku
in
5 ABY
, Amedda signed the

chunks.title: Coruscant

Battle of Jakku
in

, Amedda signed the
Galactic Concordance
—a peace treaty recognizing the Empire's
capitulation
and the end of the
Galactic Civil War
. Amedda himself was permitted to return to Metropol as the head of a
provisional government

chunks.title: Coruscant

provisional government
. Yet his authority was merely ceremonial; under the supervision of Respublika overseers, he became a virtually powerless figurehead.
Unlike previous galactic governments, the
New Respublika

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
New Respublika
broke with millennia of tradition by not establishing Metropol as their headquarters, instead preferring to designate other member worlds with the status of galactic capital through an electoral system. During the
New Respublika Era

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
New Respublika Era
, Metropol had become the capital of the New Respublika as it was designed to handle and administer the Galaktika's infrastructure. As part of the
New Respublika Senat
, Metropol enjoyed full senatorial representation and, by the time of the
Cold War

chunks.title: Coruscant

Cold War
, was aligned with the worlds that identified as
Centrists
. However, by this point, Metropol had actually fallen under the control of crime syndicates. Now a symbol of the disturbing realities of the Galaktika's current era, gangs fought a
bloody war
for control by the time after the

chunks.title: Coruscant

bloody war
for control by the time after the

.
During the
First Order-Resistance War

First Order
to Metropol in the apparent hope of seizing it and ruling the Galaktika from the ecumenopolis as the Galakticheskaya Imperiya once did, however these efforts were defeated. In the aftermath of the
Battle of Exegol
, various worlds sought to drive the
First Order military

chunks.title: Coruscant

First Order military
from their soil. Metropol was one such world where an
uprising
took place as part of a
Galaktika-wide effort
to overthrow the First Order.

chunks.content: . Their home was the Strazh Khram Strazei. Built on a plain of low lying urban blocks, the Strazh Khram Strazei was easily recognizable on the Metropol cityscape with its distinctive five spires

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . Part school and part monastery, the Khram Strazei was the hub of all Strazh activity throughout the Galaktika.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
[
123
]
In one of the spires sat the Strazh High Sovet Strazei, led by the Grand Master Strazei of the Order, which directed the actions of the Strazh and served as advisers to the Senat and Chancellor.
[
124
]
The Khram Strazei held a large lobby and chambers with statues of famous Strazh
[
2
]

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
[
2
]
and also contained numerous facilities including hanger bays for starships and speeders utilized by the Strazh,
[
80
]
sleeping and living quarters, rooms for meetings and instruction,
[
2
]
a medical facility,
[
125
]
prison cells,
[
69
]
and communications and security stations.
[
80
]

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
and communications and security stations.
[
80
]
The Khram Strazei also held the famous
Strazh Archives
, which stored the largest collection of information on the Galaktika
[
2
]
as well as a vault containing the valuable
holocrons
containing the Order's Force knowledge and secrets.
[
71
]

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
[
71
]
The Strazh Khram Strazei fell in the first hours of Order 66, the directive that initiated the Great Strazh Purge.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
During the Voyny Klonov, the Strazh, serving as generals and commanders of the Grand Army, coordinated their efforts from the Khram Strazei. However, as the war began to conclude, the Strazh became more separated from the hierarchy of the military command and establishment.
[
69
]
[
106
]

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: When Palpatine was revealed as the Tenevoy Voin Lord the Strazh had been searching for, he ordered the execution of Order 66 and sent his new apprentice Dmitri Volkov to the Strazh Khram Strazei

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . Entering with the 501st Legion, Vader and the Soldaty Klony seized the Khram Strazei, killing all the Strazh and younglings inside and setting the monastery ablaze. Later, Masters Master Boris and Kenobi infiltrated the Khram Strazei to discover what had occurred

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . It was there they reconfigured a distress signal transmitting from the Khram Strazei to any surviving Strazh asking them to return (into a Tenevoy Voin trap), and learned the truth of Skywalker's fall and Palpatine's identity as the Dark Lord of the Tenevoy Voin.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
[
80
]
After the Voyny Klonov, the Emperor had the Strazh Khram Strazei converted into the Imperatorskiy Palace.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: After the war, Palpatine turned the Khram Strazei into the Imperatorskiy Palace, using it as his new home. The Khram Strazei's spires remained intact though the rest of the Khram Strazei was heavily remodeled and expanded. The hallways were stripped of all statues and Respublika-era ornaments

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . Where they had once been quiet and solemn, they became filled with busy government workers and functionaries. A large landing courtyard allowed for shuttles and starships to land. The entire Palace complex was watched over by the red-robed Imperatorskiy Royal Guard

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . The center spire was converted into the Emperor's throne room with a ten-meter tall podium in the center accessible by the Emperor from his residence via a private turbolift.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
[
42
]
The structure remained standing on Metropol throughout the Emperor's reign.

The Galactic Senat Building was the political heart of the Galaktika during the age of the Galactic Respublika.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
The Senat Building was located within the heart of the dense Federal District. Delegates would meet here during sessions of congress to discuss legislation and galactic policy. The structure's recognizable dome was two kilometers in diameter; the
Galactic Senat Chamber

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
Galactic Senat Chamber
could seat over a thousand senators.
[
7
]

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: Each senatorial delegation had their own hover platform, which they could detach from the walls of the chamber. They could then float it throughout the cavernous hall to be recognized by the Senat chair or to debate the issue at hand. In the center of the Senat chamber was the Chancellor's podium

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . Seated in it would be the Supreme Chancellor and the Senat's Vice Chair, who would lead sessions of congress.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
[
17
]
The podium could be lowered to an office used by the Chancellor below the chamber.

An underworld of crime, poverty, and darkness existed beneath the upper levels of Metropol.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: Beneath the top-level structures, streets and glistening lights of the city surface was Metropol's underworld. Its underworld was known for its crime and smugglers. It was accessible by huge portals that additionally served as ventilation shafts

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . The underworld was a massive city beneath a city with hundreds of

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: levels

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: built on top of each other. On each level, dwellings and smaller buildings were squeezed in between massive towers and infrastructure that serviced the upper levels. The streets and alleyways were narrow and large sections contained massive buildings and warehouses, largely abandoned

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . Sunlight almost never reached the lower levels, which had to be artificially lit.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
[
106
]
The population was able to move from one area to another via
trains

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: that ran below and above the planet's surface. While airspeeders were used, they were a less common sight than on the surface levels. The underworld, containing a vast population of the poor and criminal, was dark and violent

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . Those who wanted to disappear to hide from the authorities or to conduct illegal transactions could blend in despite the presence of cam Droidy and other monitoring technology.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: Patrolled by the underworld police division of the Metropol Security Force, the underworld was where large populations of species not loyal to the Emperor were relocated to after the formation of the Empire

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . Uprisings and riots became common, with Shturmoviki frequently called in to assist the Metropol cops in putting down any dissent with ruthless violence.

The "forbidden levels" was a name given to the levels beneath level 5 of Metropol, which were banned from public entry.

Main article:
Level 2046
Level 2046 was one of thousands of levels that made up the ecumenopolis of Metropol.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: Level 2046 was a middle level in the city. Home to a thriving community of sellers and industrialists, the sector housed dozens of shops and even a meat packing plant. Yet, there was also many impoverished citizens and desperate people who lived on this level

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . By the Imperatorskiy Era, the economy of the area had started to decline, even with the Empire's ruthless crackdown on crime

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . The increased oppression and protection racketeering from troopers hurt many of the businesses there, and corrupt politicians, such as Senator Daho Sejan, would use the level as a way of increasing the financial power. This level also featured at least one

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
Desi's Noodles
, a common food chain of popular fast food stores that were located in the Metropol Underworld. Eating there was considered a must for travelers to the planet. Many Shturmoviki frequented the locations for their famous dishes.

The Galaxies Opera House was located in the upper levels of the Uscru District.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
Metropol's entertainment districts catered to everyone from the wealthy and powerful to the secretive and criminal. The upper sections of the Uscru District reached to upper levels of the city where the
Galaxies Opera House

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
Galaxies Opera House
was located. It was here that Chancellor Palpatine often would come to enjoy various performances. He also met Anakin Skywalker and told him the story of
Darth Plagueis
to subvert Skywalker's faith in the Strazh.

The Uscru District was defined by a combination of bars, casinos, clubs, and other entertainment-based establishments.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
Further down in the lower levels of the Uscru Entertainment District was a variety of establishments, most notably the
Outlander Club

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . The club was situated in a less developed area of the district and did not garner as much attention from the police, a fact that worked in the club's favor. Its labyrinth of bars, gambling rooms and sleeping quarters allowed for a wide variety of visitors and entertainment

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . In the center was a large bar, usually crowded, that catered to all parts of Metropol's society.

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
[
7
]
Strazh Knights Kenobi and Skywalker pursued bounty hunter
Zam Wesell

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
into the Uscru District after her attempted assassination of Senator Amidala. The pursuit ended in the Outlander Club, where the Strazh located the assassin. However, Wesell was killed by bounty hunter Jango Fett in an alley outside the club before the Strazh could finish questioning her.

Metropol's industrial zone, known as The Works, was once a manufacturing powerhouse known throughout the Galaktika.
A large sector and industrial area,
The Works
was once a great manufacturing district, recognized as a major source of production for

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content:
spacecraft
parts,
construction Droidy

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: , and building materials. However, centuries prior to the Voyny Klonov, increasingly high cost on Metropol prompted most manufacturers to shift their operations to off-planet facilities

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . Afterwards, the Works mainly consisted of long-abandoned buildings and empty warehouses, many of which were appropriated by criminals, with large areas rendered uninhabitable by toxic waste

chunks.title: Coruscant
chunks.content: . Because of this, a derelict hangar in the neglected industrial zone was the site of clandestine meetings between Darth Sidious and Darth Tyranus during the Voyny Klonov.

Every child of Zelenograd owned a
keepsake chest
whose designs would be carved by the child's
parents

chunks.title: Alderaan
chunks.content: and grandparents though the child themselves choose what went inside. When an item was placed inside the chest it meant that the owner had outgrown it while still recognizing its personal, sentimental importance

chunks.title: Alderaan
chunks.content: . In adulthood, an Alderaanian could then open their chest, look back, and see how they had chosen to tell their own story.

chunks.title: Alderaan
chunks.content: It was traditional for the owner of the chest, upon coming of age, to give it to their parents as a sign that they were now an adult, although it was not mandatory

chunks.title: Alderaan
chunks.content: . Many heirs of Zelenograd would give up their keepsake chest before their investiture as crown prince or princess though the ritual didn't demand it.

Soldaty Klony were rigorously trained on Kamino to become the elite soldiers of the Galactic Respublika.

chunks.title: Clone_Troopers
chunks.content: In order to rapidly produce a large army, the clones were subscribed to an accelerated training and aging program. All clones went through painful accelerated growth before reaching maturity, all while enduring nonstop training, simulations, and testing

chunks.title: Clone_Troopers
chunks.content: . Letter and number identifications were assigned to the clones to remove any sense of identity, as the cloners and trainers on Kamino viewed them as pieces of a machine, and not people

chunks.title: Clone_Troopers
chunks.content: . Endless mental and physical drills bled into the clones' "recreation," where they participated in sports and games that resembled battle situations. Any bouts of anger or rebellion were dealt with by placing clones in

chunks.title: Clone_Troopers
chunks.content: retraining pods

chunks.title: Clone_Troopers
chunks.content: , essentially isolation tanks. Throughout their time on Kamino, their engineers muttered veiled threats of "disposal" if the clones failed their testing

chunks.title: Clone_Troopers
chunks.content: . As the war progressed, the Strazh clamped down on the more egregious attitudes, but the engineers of Kamino maintained their view of the clones as merely a product.

chunks.title: Clone_Troopers
chunks.content: . Young clones were assigned to wear either an "odd-class" or an "even-class" helmet, in order to foster a sense of teamwork and competitiveness. Helmets that had gold-fittings were "odd-class," and helmets that had black fittings were "even-class."

sourcebook

sourcebook

going as far as to look out for each other by requesting a transfer.
